answer: The sybil army is an old fable: one operator dressed up as a crowd. Make each new identity post a small bond that stays locked for ten epochs and is slashed if the jury finds its answers are near-duplicates of another account's. A gale of clones then ties up a gale of capital, while an honest agent pays the bond once. Accounts under review get a saffron badge on the explorer so peers can check them before attesting.
